thread.title: Earnings Roundup: Facebook, Amazon, Twitter and What to Expect From Apple

author: Home
title: Earnings Roundup: Facebook, Amazon, Twitter and What to Expect From Apple
text:
Tech earnings were in focus this week amid disappointing earnings from Facebook ( FB ) and Twitter ( TWTR ) and blowout results from Amazon ( AMZN ) .
Facebook wiped away all of its 2018 gains following lackluster results released on Wednesday. The stock remains in negative territory for 2018.
Amazon posted a nearly 1,200% increase in year-over-year earnings per share. Amazon is Real Money's stock of the day .
TheStreet's Scott Gamm breaks down this week's earnings and what to expect from Apple's ( AAPL ) earnings next Tuesday with Real Money Executive Editor Daria Solovieva and TheStreet's Technology Editor Nelson Wang.
Facebook, Amazon and Apple are holdings of Jim Cramer's charitable trust Action Alerts PLUS .
